title: BitClub Network on BlockChain - Bitcoin - ICELAND
description: Our mining facilities in #Iceland. The machines that generate our Bitcoins. Our company #BitclubNetwork is the only reputable ...

asr.full_text: yeah wow I'm super excited to be here in Iceland right behind me the mining facility owned by Bitcoin Network lot of you coming in from Achiever's Club in Africa Andorra Uganda you've invested into mining Bitcoin at Bitcoin Network. We're hearing us telling you that our mining facilities located in Iceland now guess what its right behind me. I've just gone inside, I've seen our machines, inside there we have the Antminer-S90. What I'm holding right here these are the S-Five, an older generation and I'm bringing one to you Hanang in South Africa and this one we are bringing to Kenya. So this is really exciting to be here to see how big our facility is. We have 10,000 machines right behind me. You can hear the noise. The weather may be cold, but the headphones are very warm, especially if you have the renewable energy. Thank you so much. Looking forward to bringing a lot of you from Africa here, to visit the facility and look at it in person. Thank you very much, and bye-bye.
